name: agent-machines
description: Portable restore-machinestate for Copilot CLI. Converges the current machine to desired state declared in in-repo requirement packages -- Copilot settings first, then applications, services, and custom modules. The engine is generic; sensitive OS-mutating modules and per-machine data stay in each harness repo. Machine-scoped union restore with a seven-disposition model (enforce/ensure-present/capture-only/ignore/exclude/prune/prerequisite-check) and a conflict validator.
